summary: AR fails 3 hard gates. Two assumptions are missing required fields, one high-risk assumption has no validation plan, and two assumptions cannot be traced to PFD or VH content.

blocking_issues.description: ASM-4 is missing the 'impact if false' field. ASM-9 is missing both 'current evidence' and 'validation method' fields. All required fields must be present for every assumption.

ASM-6 references 'VH §4' but the frozen VH does not have a §4 — it has sections labeled by hypothesis ID. ASM-11 lists no source reference at all. Every assumption must trace to a specific, verifiable location in the frozen PFD or VH.
ASM-3 is rated High risk but has no entry in the Validation Plan. Every high-risk assumption must have a concrete validation method in the plan.
